notablePrerequisites: You control an additional green or red creature.
description:
Cast Horned Kavu by tapping Fallaji Wayfarer and a green or red creature.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
